_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Grade 10-12 Geography Syllabus' (2013, published by CDC), Section C (Elements of Human Geography) — all of Grade 11. Topic/sub-topic names and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns are omitted for the same column-extraction-reliability reason documented in the Grade 10 file. Outcome text and order were manually traced against each sub-topic heading rather than trusted from the printed codes alone. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 11 is modeled as a single term here.

topics.name: 11.2 Fuel and Energy
topics.description: Section C: Elements of Human Geography.

competencies.description: Explain different sources of fuel and energy
Distinguish methods of transportation of fuel and energy

topics.name: 11.3 World Population
topics.description: Section C: Elements of Human Geography.

competencies.description: Locate on a world map areas of high, medium and low population densities
Describe major factors influencing world population distribution and density
Explain factors influencing population change and structure
Explain factors which have contributed to rapid population growth
Describe the consequences of increased world population
Explain reasons and implications for migrations
Describe human survival strategies in relation to resource availability and utilization
